_comment: ArtCraft engine versions voidflare has tested its apps against with the real engine (cargo test --release -p vf-core --test engine_compat -- --nocapture). A pack reuses the engine installed on the PC only if its exact version is listed here; anything else gets our bundled copy. 'Tested' means one small real conversion per engine (see tests/engine_compat.rs), not every document type: real office files still need a trial before a version is trusted for them. CADCraft is deliberately absent: the official build still draws tilted blocks wrongly (storytold/cadcraft#1158). Add a version only after it PASSES in the matrix, and keep the pinned one from engines.json.
